sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Honourable Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.8747 Of 2022
Order:

-
A Crime No.590 of 2021 dated 14.07.2021 at Patamata Police Station, Vijayawada City, Krishna District, against the petitioner under Sections 270 and 273 of Indian Penal Code on the ground that the petitioner was caught storing tobacco and tobacco products.
2.
The cases are being booked against persons, who are found to be either storing or transporting tobacco or tobacco products in the State of Andhra Pradesh.

Persons, who are facing such cases,
have been approaching this Court for relief.

3. In Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch dated 18.12.2019, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held that tobacco does not fall within the definitions of "food" and as such, registration of Crime under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is not permissible.

4. In W.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held the police would not have jurisdiction to initiate or investigate any offences punishable under the provision of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A learned Single Judge had also held that transport or storage of tobacco and tobacco products would not constitute an offence punishable under Sections 270 to 273 of Indian Penal Code.

5. In view of the aforesaid findings which are being consistently followed by this Court, this Criminal Petition is disposed of quashing the Crime No.590 of 2021 dated 14.07.2021 at Patamata Police Station, Vijayawada City, Krishna District, against the petitioner..

JUSTICE D.RAMESH Date: 07.11.2022 Psr.
THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH (Disposed of) CRIMINAL PETITION No.8747 of 2022 07.11.2022 psr Pendyala Sathyanarayana vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 7 November, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54933465/
